meta.name: customer-onboarding-and-implementation
meta.description: Takes a new customer from signature to working — setting a definition of live that both sides agreed before the contract was signed, planning and staffing the implementation, running data migration and integration realistically, training the people who will actually use it, and handing over to the ongoing relationship. Use this to design an onboarding motion, rescue a stalled implementation, work out why customers who bought never went live, or scope the services a deal actually needs.

copy.tagline: 帮新客户从签约走到正式启用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责让签约客户真正用起来
copy.tagline_en: Help new customers go from signed contract to actual go-live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're in charge of getting signed customers to genuinely use the product

howto.what: 它帮客户从签约走到真正能用：设定双方一致同意的上线标准，安排实施计划、数据迁移和用户培训，最后带背景信息地把项目交接出去。
howto.when: 当你要求设计客户上线流程、挽救停滞的实施，或查明买了却没启用的原因等时触发。

say.text: 帮我起草上线标准，写清客户和我方各自的交付职责。
say.note: 会引导你落实到具体团队和日期。

say.text: 有个客户实施停滞了，帮我复盘并给出推进方案。
say.note: 会检查是否缺客户方负责人或数据前提。

say.text: 客户快上线了，怎么培训才能让大家真正用起来？
say.note: 会建议贴近岗位的实操训练而非功能讲解。

howto.what_en: It guides a customer from contract signature to actual use: setting a mutually agreed go-live definition, planning and staffing the implementation, running data migration and training realistically, and handing over deliberately.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design an onboarding plan, rescue a stalled implementation, or find out why buyers never went live.

say_en.text: Draft a go-live definition specifying what we and the customer deliver.
say_en.note: Guides you to assign teams and dates.

say_en.text: A customer implementation is stuck; help me review and fix it.
say_en.note: Checks for a missing customer owner or data issues.

say_en.text: How should we train the customer so people actually use it?
say_en.note: Suggests job-based practice, not feature demos.
